maps.points.tower_level3.a03.title: Go downstairs → Tower Level 2
maps.points.tower_level3.b01.detail: Push the two wizard statues to the outer side of the sensors at (1, -11) and (5, -11). Push the two knight statues to the inner side of the sensors at (2, -11) and (4, -11). Open the hidden door.
maps.points.tower_level3.detail: The painting depicts wolves in a dark forest. For a moment, they seem almost alive. The bloodstain on the floor beneath it does little to make the scene less unsettling.
maps.points.tower_level3.detail-2: Interact with the wolf pack in the painting (1, -9)
maps.points.tower_level3.detail-3: The stone chamber is filled with a damp, rotting smell. Old mucus clings to the floor, and dark stains spread between the stones.
maps.points.tower_level3.detail-4: At (8, -5) Stepped on by the party
maps.points.tower_level3.dialogue: The chamber reeks of damp rot. Old slime clings to the floor and dark stains creep across the stone.
maps.points.tower_level3.dialogue-2: Yet paintings cover the walls. Marshes beneath pale skies. Black water, reeds, distant hills. Some are remarkably good.
maps.points.tower_level3.dialogue-3: The familiar apparition takes shape among them.
maps.points.tower_level3.dialogue-5: "FLESH AND MAGIC, GIVEN FORM BY MY HAND."
maps.points.tower_level3.dialogue-6: His gaze passes over the paintings.
maps.points.tower_level3.dialogue-7: "YET IT FOUND BEAUTY WHERE I HAD GIVEN IT NONE."
maps.points.tower_level3.dialogue-8: "IN TIME, I SENT IT TO THE MARSH."
maps.points.tower_level3.dialogue-9: "THERE IT KEPT WATCH OVER ONE OF THE KEYS."
maps.points.tower_level3.l01.detail: This box has no fixed content set
